caption: Your own picture over a mob, no Zeal release needed

steps.label: Drop a file
steps.sub: EUR.png in uifiles/zeal/tagicons (or its custom folder)

steps.label: Checked first
steps.sub: PNG or TGA, 1 MB or less, 128 px a side or less

steps.label: /tag icons
steps.sub: lists what was found and rescans the folder

steps.label: /tag local ^IEUR^Europa
steps.sub: the picture floats above the mob and faces you

steps.label: Bad or missing file
steps.sub: the built-in shape (or a white arrow) is drawn instead
